source_system_examples: ERP GL, FP&A planning, Apptio, TBM, Adaptive, Anaplan
capture_guidance: Capture approved FY budget by portfolio, function, platform, cost center, and shared-service allocation. Include fiscal year and approval version.
if_missing: Dashboard can show coverage only; cannot claim budget total.
dashboard_use: Top-line IT budget, budget by function, spend-at-risk denominator
notes: Must be committed budget, not value at stake.

source_system_examples: FP&A budget model, TBM taxonomy, Apptio, IT planning workbook
capture_guidance: Classify each budget line as run, change, or mixed. If mixed, provide split percent or allocation logic.
if_missing: AbarVa may derive from spend_type only if client approves taxonomy; otherwise not_loaded.
dashboard_use: Run/change KPI, modernization posture, invest-vs-operate story
notes: Do not infer from vendor name alone.

source_system_examples: ERP GL, fixed asset ledger, capitalization policy, project accounting
capture_guidance: Capture budget and actuals by accounting treatment. Include capitalization policy or GL account mapping.
if_missing: Demo may synthesize a reconciled split; real client should mark not_loaded until finance source is provided.
dashboard_use: CapEx/OpEx chart, accounting posture, investment mix
notes: Synthetic split must reconcile to budget envelope and be labeled synthetic.

source_system_examples: ERP actuals, AP, procurement spend cube, cloud billing, project ledger
capture_guidance: Capture actual spend through a period-end date at same grain as budget or provide bridge table from actuals to budget lines.
if_missing: Dashboard shows committed budget but actual/YTD remains partial.
dashboard_use: Spent YTD KPI, burn rate, forecast risk
notes: Need as-of date. Do not mix invoice date and service period without basis.

source_system_examples: FP&A forecast, EPM, project forecast workbook
capture_guidance: Capture latest forecast with version date and owner.
if_missing: Show no forecast; avoid overrun claims.

source_system_examples: ERP company code, legal entity, cost center hierarchy, shared services allocation model
capture_guidance: Capture legal entity or portfolio company for each budget/spend line. For shared services, capture allocation basis and percent.
if_missing: Dashboard can show enterprise total but cannot slice by company.
dashboard_use: Holding-company Tower view, portfolio-company spend and ROI
notes: Critical for Lakeshore/Morgan-style holding company story.

source_system_examples: CLM, procurement, Coupa, Ariba, SAP, Oracle, ServiceNow SAM
capture_guidance: Capture vendor master id, contract id, annual contract value, renewal date, system/service supported, and owner.
if_missing: Vendor charts are partial; renewal/watch windows become unreliable.
notes: Separate contract value from annual spend.

source_system_examples: PPM, Jira Align, ADO, ServiceNow SPM, Smartsheet, PMO workbook
capture_guidance: Capture named initiatives with owner, sponsor, budget, stage, status, and link to capability/system/value lever.
if_missing: Cannot rank programs; chat must say initiative budget not loaded.
dashboard_use: Top programs, portfolio ranking, budget concentration
notes: Program budget is not total IT budget.

source_system_examples: Project ledger, timesheets, AP, cloud tags, SOW invoices
capture_guidance: Map actual spend to initiative ids. Include labor/vendor/cloud categories and as-of period.
dashboard_use: Burn rate, value vs spend, scale/hold decisions
notes: Actuals need same initiative ids as budget.

source_system_examples: Benefits realization ledger, finance attestation, KPI system, operational telemetry
capture_guidance: Capture realized value by initiative, period, measurement method, baseline, owner, and finance attestation.
if_missing: Dashboard can show promised value, but ROI must be marked unproven.
dashboard_use: ROI signal, value capture, outcomes tab
notes: Do not use promised benefit as measured value.

source_system_examples: Business case, charter, investment committee memo
capture_guidance: Capture original business-case value and value type with date/version.
if_missing: Can still operate on spend, but value thesis missing.
notes: Separate hard dollar, avoidance, productivity, risk reduction.

source_system_examples: ServiceNow, Jira, ERP ops, contact center, supply chain, EHR, OMS, WMS
capture_guidance: Capture KPIs tied to initiatives and business functions. Include baseline, current, target, period, and owner.
if_missing: Tower cannot prove operational outcome; only spend/program status.
dashboard_use: Outcomes tab, operational proof, value realization

source_system_examples: M365 admin, GitHub/Copilot, ServiceNow, Workday, Salesforce, app telemetry
capture_guidance: Capture numerator and denominator: active users/cases and eligible population. Include period.
notes: Do not compare tools without denominator.

source_system_examples: RAID log, GRC, PMO, security risk register, model risk
capture_guidance: Capture risk/blocker per initiative/program with severity, owner, mitigation, due date, and status.
if_missing: Pressure score remains partial and should not be overclaimed.
dashboard_use: Active pressure, spend at risk, board warnings
notes: Needs canonical formula before dashboard scoring.

capture_guidance: Every row must carry source, row/cell/sheet/page when possible, upload run id, and freshness.
notes: This is non-negotiable for all client data.

capture_guidance: Every derived metric must have formula name/version, basis, period, and owner.
if_missing: Metric can display as raw only, no derived benchmark/score.
